# openstack-nova-operator-kog — LLM doc index (pinned: 0.1.0)
# One line per file; regenerate the pin on release. Read files at the tag that matches the
# running build: the chart version is CompositionDefinition.spec.chart.version and equals
# appVersion, and it is the published chart's tag — one tag covers chart, CRDs and these docs.
docs/index.md: the map — what the blueprint is + links to the whole bundle and the repo layout
docs/overview.md: the KOG packaging, the RestDefinition-per-resource model, the request flow, the native apiKey auth
docs/usage.md: install the chart or the Composition, fetch a Keystone token, create Nova CRs, refresh the token
docs/configuration.md: the whole values surface — the RestDefinition toggles, nova.url, and apiKey auth
docs/api.md: the CompositionDefinition CRD, the generated OpenstackNovaOperatorKog CRD, the Nova CRD kinds
docs/examples.md: index of the runnable examples and the worked sample CRs
docs/release.md: how a tag publishes the chart to the org's OCI charts/ namespace on GHCR
docs/log.md: curated history
docs/architecture.md: diagram + design rationale, including why the header-rewrite proxy is needed today
docs/quickstart.md: the shortest path from install to a VM in Horizon
docs/e2e.md: the full OVH Public Cloud walkthrough on a kind cluster, with cleanup
docs/e2e-krateo-openstack.md: the walkthrough against a self-hosted Krateo-blueprint OpenStack, with screenshots
docs/medium-article.md: long-form write-up — kubectl apply to a running OVH VM, and the bugs hit on the way
docs/medium-openstack-compute-operator.md: long-form write-up — the operator against a blueprint-deployed OpenStack
examples/nova-composition/README.md: install the blueprint as a Krateo Composition (OpenstackNovaOperatorKog CR)
examples/nova-composition/composition.yaml: the example Composition CR — auth bridge + toggled RestDefinitions
# Source (read at the same tag; the docs above are derived from these):
chart/values.yaml: every value with its rationale in comments
chart/values.schema.json: the typed schema core-provider derives the generated Composition CRD from
chart/templates/rd-server.yaml: a RestDefinition template (one per resource, toggled by values)
chart/assets/server.yaml: the Nova Servers OAS subset bundled into a ConfigMap
chart/samples/nova-auth.yaml: the InstanceConfiguration referencing the nova-token bearer Secret
chart/samples/test-server.yaml: a sample Instance CR (a Nova server)
chart/samples/extra-resources.yaml: sample ComputeFlavor / ComputeKeypair / ComputeServerGroup / ComputeAggregate CRs
scripts/get-token.sh: the Keystone v3 token fetcher; --secret emits a ready-to-apply Secret
compositiondefinition.yaml: this component's own registration (spec.chart.version = the published chart)
